recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core specification branch. If the descendant max=0 or fixed-value suppression details need fresh verification, test and patch the current publisher/kindling renderer rather than editing generated output or adding redundant prose in HL7/fhir.
issue_request: FHIR-12730 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked for profile vocabulary binding lists to omit bindings on max=0 elements, descendants of max=0 elements, and ideally bindings made irrelevant by fixed values, while making must-support bindings more prominent.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit mentioning FHIR-12730 was found. The Jira comment links to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#272, whose comments broadened the work into tab-specific StructureDefinition vocabulary, invariant, and data-dictionary views, recorded a Grahame Grieve/Elliot Silver 4-0-0 motion to apply the change, and closed the issue as Done on 2022-10-18.
additional_context: The current FHIR checkout has no Java publisher source; build.gradle.kts depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling and invokes org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher. Current public publisher source contains the relevant StructureDefinition terminology-list rendering methods, including direct max=0 filtering and must-support/key-element filtered views. Confluence FHIR IG Authoring minutes discuss the linked publisher issue as rendering work, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no HL7/fhir source changes because the issue's implementation surface is external publisher/kindling tooling rather than a build-scoped FHIR source artifact in this checkout.
